title: Con Fire Annual Open House
location: Contra Costa Fire Training Center, 2945 Treat Blvd, Concord
organizer: Contra Costa County Fire Protection District (Con Fire)
description: Fire Prevention Week open house for the whole family: live demos, education booths, fire apparatus, food trucks, and a chance to meet the crews. This year's theme is "Charge Into Fire Safety" (lithium-ion battery safety).

title: MOFD Pancake Breakfast & Open House
location: MOFD Fire Station 41, 1284 Moraga Way, Moraga
description: Annual Fire Prevention Week open house and pancake breakfast with station tours, firefighters, and safety info. Check mofd.org for hours before going.

title: Lamorinda CERT Monthly Meeting: Earthquakes
description: Local earthquake consequences, including water availability and quality, with speakers from LMOCERT and EBMUD. The registration form opens the Zoom; don't submit it before 6:50 PM.

title: Great California ShakeOut earthquake drill
description: Statewide Drop, Cover, and Hold On drill. Households and neighborhood groups can register to take part.

title: 4th Annual Lamorinda Public Safety Day
location: St. Anselm's Episcopal Church, 682 Michael Ln, Lafayette
description: Family morning with kids' activities, free food, and safety info from Lafayette Police, Contra Costa County Fire Prevention, the American Red Cross, CERT, PG&E, the Lamorinda Radio Interest Group, and Contra Costa Search & Rescue. Fire truck visit at 10 AM.

title: Safe at Scale: "Weathered: After the LA Firestorm" screening and wildfire panel
description: PBS documentary on lessons from the January 2025 LA fires, followed by a panel with Sen. Tim Grayson, Asm. Rebecca Bauer-Kahan, MOFD Chief Jeff Isaacs, director Trip Jennings, and IBHS's Steve Hawks on home hardening and insurance-relevant mitigation.

title: Con Fire free CPR/AED skills session
location: Contra Costa Fire Training Center, 2945 Treat Blvd, Concord
cost: Free · ages 14+ · live or work in the district
description: Complete the free online AHA Heartsaver course first, then attend this in-person skills session. Lafayette is in Con Fire's district. (The Oct 20, Oct 24, and Nov 17 sessions are full.)
